customManagers.description: The contracts tag web/buf.gen.yaml generates the web app's client from (those-who-run/paddock#127). A bump PR also needs `npm run api` in web/: its CI fails on the stale client until then.

The images the end-to-end set-up runs, pinned by tag and digest (web/e2e/global-setup.ts; those-who-run/paddock#130 R5): NATS and logbook. A bump PR runs the e2e job against them. The store in web/e2e/store was made with the logbook web/e2e/store/make.go names; a newer logbook migrates it as it opens it.

packageRules.description: One contracts version for the Go API (go.mod) and the web app's generated client (web/buf.gen.yaml): one PR bumps both, and web/scripts/contracts.ts fails while they differ.

One Node for the web app: web/.node-version, which make web-check and CI use, and the image's web stage in the Dockerfile (those-who-run/paddock#131). One PR bumps both; tests/test_dockerfile.py fails while they differ.
